quote: The specific problem about whether categoricity in ℵₙ for all n < ω implies categoricity in every cardinal for atomic classes appears in Shelah's 1983 paper, where he introduced the concept of "excellent" atomic classes and left open the question of whether this property could be derived for general atomic classes.
note: Shelah's foundational work on categoricity began earlier (1974-1975), but the specific problem about atomic models was formally posed in his 1983 paper "Classification theory for non-elementary classes I: The number of uncountable models of ψ ∈ L_{ω₁,ω}. Part A" published in Israel Journal of Mathematics, volume 46, pages 212–240.
